# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 7 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 7:2 — no one to flee vs. no one to whom I can flee

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "no one to whom I can flee" | Literal — dative relative clause |
| LOGOS | "no one to whom I can flee for safety" | Adds 'for safety' as implied object |
| PNEUMA | "nowhere to run, no one to help me" | Paraphrase |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS adds 'for safety' which is implied by the context (kataphygo). PNEUMA splits the single clause into two. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 7:3 — Father of orphans — title of God

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "Father of all orphans" | Literal pater orphanōn |
| LOGOS | "Father of orphans" | Drops 'all' as redundant |
| PNEUMA | "Father of the orphaned" | Adjectival form |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** EMET's 'all' follows the Greek pas. 'Father of all orphans' is more precise. Adopted EMET.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---
